name: Galileo AI
tagline: Galileo AI generates detailed, editable UI designs from text descriptions — producing screens complete with layout, components, imagery, and copy in seconds. Output is directly importable into Figma for refinement, letting designers use AI-generated designs as a starting point rather than building from a blank canvas. Product teams and early-stage startups use it to rapidly prototype interface concepts before committing engineering resources.
